message.content:
**The Thinker** by Auguste Rodin (originally conceived in 1880‑1881) is widely regarded as the most iconic sculpture of the 19th century.  
Rodin’s bronze figure—first cast in 1902 but based on sketches from the 1880s—has become a symbol of contemplation and artistic genius, and it remains one of the most reproduced and celebrated works in Western art history.
